I also noticed `src/inventory.ts:6` has `if (have <= qty)`, which refuses a reservation that would take stock to exactly zero. Its doc comment says it takes `qty` units "if that many are left", so that looks like an off-by-one, but it is outside this task's scope and I did not change it.
